A component for configuring and setting bonding curves for token markets

## Parameters

### \_\_namedParameters

`BondingCurveCardProps`

## Returns

`Element`

## Component

## Description

BondingCurveCard provides an interface for configuring and setting bonding curves
for token markets. It combines a configurator component for setting ask and bid
prices with functionality to commit these settings to the blockchain.

Features:
- Bonding curve configuration
- Ask and bid price management
- On-chain curve setting
- Loading state handling
- Error handling
- Customizable styling

## Example

```tsx
<BondingCurveCard
  marketAddress="market_address_here"
  connection={solanaConnection}
  publicKey={userPublicKey}
  solanaWallet={wallet}
  setLoading={setIsLoading}
/>
```

> **default**(`__namedParameters`): `Element`

Defined in: [src/components/tokenMill/BondingCurveConfigurator.tsx:87](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/tokenMill/BondingCurveConfigurator.tsx#L87)

A component for configuring bonding curves with visual feedback

## Parameters

### \_\_namedParameters

`BondingCurveConfiguratorProps`

## Returns

`Element`

## Component

## Description

BondingCurveConfigurator provides an interactive interface for configuring
bonding curves with real-time visual feedback. It supports multiple curve types
and allows users to adjust various parameters through sliders.

Features:
- Multiple curve types (linear, power, exponential, logarithmic)
- Real-time curve visualization
- Adjustable parameters:
  - Number of points
  - Base price
  - Top price
  - Power (for power curves)
  - Fee percentage
- Platform-specific optimizations
- Loading states
- Customizable styling

## Example

```tsx
<BondingCurveConfigurator
  onCurveChange={(askPrices, bidPrices) => {
    console.log('New curve prices:', {askPrices, bidPrices});
  }}
/>
```

# Function: TopNavigation()

> **TopNavigation**(`props`, `deprecatedLegacyContext`?): `ReactNode`

Defined in: [src/components/topNavigation/topNavigation.tsx:40](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/topNavigation/topNavigation.tsx#L40)

A navigation bar component for the top of the screen

## Parameters

### props

`TopNavigationProps`

### deprecatedLegacyContext?

`any`

**Deprecated**

**See**

[React Docs](https://legacy.reactjs.org/docs/legacy-context.html#referencing-context-in-lifecycle-methods)

## Returns

`ReactNode`

## Component

## Description

TopNavigation provides a consistent navigation bar at the top of the screen.
The component features:
- Section name display with customizable text
- Back arrow navigation
- Contextual icons based on view:
  - Messages icon
  - Notifications bell
  - Menu dots

The component adapts its display based on whether a section name is provided,
showing different sets of icons accordingly.

## Example

```tsx
// With section name
<TopNavigation sectionName="Profile" />

// Without section name (shows all icons)
<TopNavigation />
```

# Function: default()

> **default**(`props`, `deprecatedLegacyContext`?): `ReactNode`

Defined in: [src/components/wallet/EmbeddedWallet.tsx:53](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/wallet/EmbeddedWallet.tsx#L53)

A component that provides embedded wallet authentication functionality

## Parameters

### props

[`EmbeddedWalletAuthProps`](../interfaces/EmbeddedWalletAuthProps.mdx)

### deprecatedLegacyContext?

`any`

**Deprecated**

**See**

[React Docs](https://legacy.reactjs.org/docs/legacy-context.html#referencing-context-in-lifecycle-methods)

## Returns

`ReactNode`

## Component

## Description

EmbeddedWalletAuth is a component that handles wallet authentication through
various providers (Google, Apple, Email) and manages the connection state.
It provides a user interface for authentication and handles wallet connection
callbacks.

Features:
- Multiple authentication methods:
  - Google Sign-In
  - Apple Sign-In
  - Email Sign-In
- Automatic wallet connection handling
- Error handling and user feedback
- Provider-specific wallet management

## Example

```tsx
<EmbeddedWalletAuth
  onWalletConnected={({provider, address}) => {
    console.log(`Connected with ${provider}: ${address}`);
  }}
  authMode="login"
/>
```

# Function: createWalletStyles()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/components/wallet/wallet.styles/functions/createWalletStyles.mdx

title: "Function: createWalletStyles()"
description: "> **createWalletStyles**(`theme`, `overrideStyles`?, `userStyleSheet`?): `object`"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../../README.mdx) / [components/wallet/wallet.styles](../README.mdx) / createWalletStyles

# Function: createWalletStyles()

> **createWalletStyles**(`theme`, `overrideStyles`?, `userStyleSheet`?): `object`

Defined in: [src/components/wallet/wallet.styles.ts:63](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/wallet/wallet.styles.ts#L63)

Creates a complete set of wallet styles by merging multiple style sources

## Parameters

### theme

The merged theme object

#### --wallet-bg-primary

`string` = `'#FFFFFF'`

Primary background color for the wallet container

#### --wallet-bg-secondary

`string` = `'#F2F3F5'`

Secondary background color for UI elements like buttons

#### --wallet-border-color

`string` = `'#EDEFF3'`

Border color for UI elements

#### --wallet-button-bg

`string` = `'#2B8EF0'`

Background color for primary action buttons

#### --wallet-button-padding

`number` = `12`

Vertical padding for buttons

#### --wallet-button-text-color

`string` = `'#FFFFFF'`

Text color for primary action buttons

#### --wallet-container-padding

`number` = `16`

Padding for the main container

#### --wallet-font-size

`number` = `14`

Base font size for text elements

#### --wallet-input-border-color

`string` = `'#E0E0E0'`

Border color for input fields

#### --wallet-input-text-color

`string` = `'#232324'`

Text color for input fields

#### --wallet-text-primary

`string` = `'#232324'`

Primary text color for main content

#### --wallet-text-secondary

`string` = `'#434445'`

Secondary text color for supporting content

### overrideStyles?

Optional explicit style overrides

### userStyleSheet?

Optional user-provided style sheet

## Returns

`object`

The final merged styles object

## Description

This function creates a complete set of wallet styles by merging styles from
multiple sources in the following order:
1. Default wallet theme
2. Optional user-provided theme
3. Base wallet styles
4. Optional user style sheet
5. Explicit override styles

The resulting styles object includes styles for:
- Container layout
- Headers and text
- Provider buttons
- Connect button
- Input fields
- Status text

## Example

```typescript
const theme = getMergedWalletTheme();
const styles = createWalletStyles(theme, {
  container: { backgroundColor: '#000' }
});
```

Defined in: [src/components/wallet/wallet.theme.ts:28](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/wallet/wallet.theme.ts#L28)

Default theme configuration for the wallet component

## Type declaration

### --wallet-bg-primary

> **--wallet-bg-primary**: `string` = `'#FFFFFF'`

Primary background color for the wallet container

### --wallet-bg-secondary

> **--wallet-bg-secondary**: `string` = `'#F2F3F5'`

Secondary background color for UI elements like buttons

### --wallet-border-color

> **--wallet-border-color**: `string` = `'#EDEFF3'`

Border color for UI elements

### --wallet-button-bg

> **--wallet-button-bg**: `string` = `'#2B8EF0'`

Background color for primary action buttons

### --wallet-button-padding

> **--wallet-button-padding**: `number` = `12`

Vertical padding for buttons

### --wallet-button-text-color

> **--wallet-button-text-color**: `string` = `'#FFFFFF'`

Text color for primary action buttons

### --wallet-container-padding

> **--wallet-container-padding**: `number` = `16`

Padding for the main container

### --wallet-font-size

> **--wallet-font-size**: `number` = `14`

Base font size for text elements

### --wallet-input-border-color

> **--wallet-input-border-color**: `string` = `'#E0E0E0'`

Border color for input fields

### --wallet-input-text-color

> **--wallet-input-text-color**: `string` = `'#232324'`

Text color for input fields

### --wallet-text-primary

> **--wallet-text-primary**: `string` = `'#232324'`

Primary text color for main content

### --wallet-text-secondary

> **--wallet-text-secondary**: `string` = `'#434445'`

Secondary text color for supporting content

## Description

WALLET_DEFAULT_THEME defines the default visual styling for the wallet component.
It uses CSS custom properties (variables) to define various aspects of the UI,
making it easy to customize the appearance while maintaining consistency.

The theme includes:
- Background colors for different UI elements
- Text colors for various content types
- Border and input field styling
- Button appearance
- Spacing and sizing measurements

## Example

```typescript
// Override specific theme values
const customTheme = {
  ...WALLET_DEFAULT_THEME,
  '--wallet-bg-primary': '#000000',
  '--wallet-text-primary': '#ffffff'
};
```

`ReactNode`

## Component

## Description

WalletCard is a comprehensive wallet interface component that shows the user's
portfolio balance, price changes, and provides quick access to common wallet
actions like swapping tokens, sending funds, and on-ramping fiat currency.

Features:
- Displays current portfolio balance in USD
- Shows price change and percentage change
- Provides quick access buttons for Swap, Send, and On-Ramp actions
- Integrates with Mercuryo for fiat on-ramping

## Example

```tsx
<WalletCard
  balance={1234.56}
  priceChange={23.45}
  percentageChange={1.2}
  onSwap={() => handleSwap()}
  onSend={() => handleSend()}
  onRamp={() => handleOnRamp()}
/>
```

---

# Function: default()

> **default**(`props`, `deprecatedLegacyContext`?): `ReactNode`

Defined in: [src/components/WalletSlide/portfolioItem/portfolioItem.tsx:49](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/components/WalletSlide/portfolioItem/portfolioItem.tsx#L49)

A component that displays individual token information in a portfolio

## Parameters

### props

`PortfolioItemProps`

### deprecatedLegacyContext?

`any`

**Deprecated**

**See**

[React Docs](https://legacy.reactjs.org/docs/legacy-context.html#referencing-context-in-lifecycle-methods)

## Returns

`ReactNode`

## Component

## Description

PortfolioItem is a reusable component that displays detailed information
about a single token in a user's portfolio. It shows:
- Token icon/logo
- Token name with verification badge
- Token amount
- USD value
- Profit/loss information

The component is designed to be used in a list of portfolio items,
providing a consistent and clean layout for token information.

## Example

```tsx
<PortfolioItem
  imagePath={require('./token-icon.png')}
  tokenName="Solana"
  tokenAmount="123.45"
  usdValue="$1,234.56"
  profit="+12.34%"
/>
```

A reusable search input component with clear functionality

## Returns

`Element`

## Component

## Description

SearchBar is a reusable component that provides a search input field with
additional features. The component includes:
- A magnifying glass icon for visual indication
- A text input field with placeholder
- Text clearing functionality
- Consistent styling with the app's design

The component maintains its own state for the search text and provides
a clean interface for text input and clearing.

## Example

```tsx
<SearchBar />
```

Note: Future iterations could include props for:
- Custom placeholder text
- Search callback function
- Custom styling options

A screen component that displays wallet and portfolio information

## Returns

`Element`

## Component

## Description

WalletSlide is a comprehensive screen component that combines multiple sub-components
to display a user's wallet and portfolio information. It includes:
- A top navigation bar
- Portfolio balance display
- Search functionality
- A scrollable list of portfolio items

The component uses SafeAreaView for proper layout on different devices and
integrates with mock portfolio data for demonstration purposes.

## Example

```tsx
<WalletSlide />
```

Summarized usage:
 1) Read which provider is set from config.
 2) If 'privy', we handle via `usePrivyWalletLogic`.
 3) If 'dynamic', we handle via `useDynamicWalletLogic`.
 4) If 'turnkey', we do not have a full usage example, but we show how you might do it.

# Function: useCoingecko()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/hooks/useCoingecko/functions/useCoingecko.mdx

title: "Function: useCoingecko()"
description: "A unified hook that fetches and manages cryptocurrency data from CoinGecko"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [hooks/useCoingecko](../README.mdx) / useCoingecko

# Function: useCoingecko()

> **useCoingecko**(): `{
>   coinList: Array<{ id: string; symbol: string; name: string }>;
>   loadingCoinList: boolean;
>   coinListError: string | null;
>   searchResults: Array<{ id: string; symbol: string; name: string }>;
>   searchCoins: (query: string) => void;
>   fetchCoinList: () => Promise<void>;
>   selectedCoinId: string;
>   setSelectedCoinId: (id: string) => void;
>   timeframe: Timeframe;
>   setTimeframe: (tf: Timeframe) => void;
>   marketCap: number;
>   liquidityScore: number;
>   fdv: number;
>   graphData: number[];
>   timestamps: number[];
>   timeframePrice: number;
>   timeframeChangeUsd: number;
>   timeframeChangePercent: number;
>   loadingMarketData: boolean;
>   loadingOHLC: boolean;
>   coinError: string | null;
>   refreshCoinData: () => Promise<void>;
> }`

Defined in: [src/hooks/useCoingecko.ts:21](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/hooks/useCoingecko.ts#L21)

A unified hook that:
1) Fetches and caches the full CoinGecko coin list (with local searching)
2) Allows selecting a single coin to fetch market data (market cap, FDV, liquidity, etc)
3) Fetches OHLC data for that coin in a chosen timeframe

All fetch logic is delegated to `coingeckoService`.

## Returns

Object containing:

### Coin List Searching
- **coinList**: Array of coins with id, symbol, and name
- **loadingCoinList**: Boolean indicating if coin list is loading
- **coinListError**: Error message if coin list fetch failed
- **searchResults**: Results after searching through coinList
- **searchCoins**: Function to search coins by name or symbol
- **fetchCoinList**: Function to manually refresh the coin list

### Single Coin Selection
- **selectedCoinId**: Current selected coin ID
- **setSelectedCoinId**: Function to change selected coin
- **timeframe**: Current timeframe for OHLC data
- **setTimeframe**: Function to change timeframe

### Market Data
- **marketCap**: Market capitalization of selected coin
- **liquidityScore**: Liquidity score (volume/market cap ratio)
- **fdv**: Fully diluted valuation

### OHLC Data
- **graphData**: Array of price data points
- **timestamps**: Array of timestamps for each data point
- **timeframePrice**: Current price in selected timeframe
- **timeframeChangeUsd**: Price change in USD
- **timeframeChangePercent**: Price change in percentage

### Status
- **loadingMarketData**: Boolean indicating if market data is loading
- **loadingOHLC**: Boolean indicating if OHLC data is loading
- **coinError**: Error message for coin data fetching

### Actions
- **refreshCoinData**: Function to manually refresh coin data

---

# Function: useFetchTokens()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/hooks/useFetchTokens/functions/useFetchTokens.mdx

title: "Function: useFetchTokens()"
description: "Hook for fetching token accounts for a Solana wallet address"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [hooks/useFetchTokens](../README.mdx) / useFetchTokens

# Function: useFetchTokens()

> **useFetchTokens**(walletAddress?: string): `{ tokens: TokenEntry[]; loading: boolean; error: string | null; }`

Defined in: [src/hooks/useFetchTokens.ts:4](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/hooks/useFetchTokens.ts#L4)

A React hook that fetches token accounts for a given Solana wallet address.
The hook automatically refetches when the wallet address changes.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `walletAddress?` | `string` | The Solana wallet address to fetch tokens for |

## Returns

| Property | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `tokens` | `TokenEntry[]` | Array of token accounts with their metadata |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Indicates if tokens are currently being fetched |
| `error` | `string` \| `null` | Error message if the fetch operation failed |

---

# Function: useTradeTransaction()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/hooks/useTradeTransaction/functions/useTradeTransaction.mdx

title: "Function: useTradeTransaction()"
description: "Hook to handle Solana trade transactions for both Privy & MWA wallets"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [hooks/useTradeTransaction](../README.mdx) / useTradeTransaction

# Function: useTradeTransaction()

```tsx
useTradeTransaction(): { 
  sendTrade: (mode: 'priority' | 'jito', recipient: string, amountSol: number) => Promise<void>; 
  replicateJupiterTrade: (tradeData: TradeData, mode: 'priority' | 'jito') => Promise<void>;
}
```

Defined in: [src/hooks/useTradeTransaction.ts:33](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/hooks/useTradeTransaction.ts#L33)

Hook to handle trade transactions for both Privy & Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA). Provides functions to:
1. Send direct SOL transfers with priority or Jito bundle transactions
2. Replicate Jupiter swap trades with provided trade data

## Returns

Object with the following methods:

### sendTrade()

```tsx
sendTrade: (mode: 'priority' | 'jito', recipient: string, amountSol: number) => Promise<void>
```

Sends a SOL transfer transaction using either priority fee or Jito bundle transaction.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                    | Description                          |
| :-------- | :---------------------- | :----------------------------------- |
| mode      | `'priority' \| 'jito'`  | Transaction mode (priority fee or Jito bundle) |
| recipient | string                  | Recipient wallet address             |
| amountSol | number                  | Amount of SOL to send                |

### replicateJupiterTrade()

```tsx
replicateJupiterTrade: (tradeData: TradeData, mode: 'priority' | 'jito') => Promise<void>
```

Replicates a Jupiter swap with the given trade data.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type       | Description                                  |
| :-------- | :--------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| tradeData | TradeData  | Object containing trade parameters           |
| mode      | `'priority' \| 'jito'` | Transaction mode (priority fee or Jito bundle) |

##### TradeData Properties
```
| Property              | Type   | Description                           |
| :-------------------- | :----- | :------------------------------------ |
| inputMint?            | string | Input token mint address              |
| outputMint?           | string | Output token mint address             |
| inputAmountLamports?  | string | Input amount in lamports              |
| outputAmountLamports? | string | Output amount in lamports             |
| token1Avatar?         | any    | Input token avatar                    |
| token1Name?           | string | Input token name                      |
| token1PriceUsd?       | string | Input token price in USD              |
| token2Avatar?         | any    | Output token avatar                   |
| token2Name?           | string | Output token name                     |
| token2PriceUsd?       | string | Output token price in USD             |
| token2PriceSol?       | string | Output token price in SOL             |
| aggregator?           | string | Aggregator used for the swap          |
```

---

# Function: default()

> **default**(`props`, `deprecatedLegacyContext`?): `ReactNode`

Defined in: [src/screens/Common/NftScreen/NftScreen.tsx:15](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/bd4b3556b8f469c27ebb06f4df65b3a36b43ba3b/src/screens/Common/NftScreen/NftScreen.tsx#L15)

Main NFT screen that shows two tabs: "Buy" and "Sell".
When "Buy" is active, it renders <BuySection/>; 
When "Sell" is active, it renders <SellSection/>.

# Function: getCoinList()

> **getCoinList**(): `Promise<Array<{ id: string; symbol: string; name: string }>>`

Defined in: [src/services/coingeckoService.ts:15](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/coingeckoService.ts#L15)

Fetches the complete list of cryptocurrencies from the CoinGecko API.
This function returns a comprehensive list of coins with their basic information.

**Note**: The raw list can be large (thousands of coins), so be mindful of performance when using this data.

## Parameters

This function does not accept any parameters.

## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<Array<{ id: string; symbol: string; name: string }>>` | Array of coin objects with id, symbol, and name properties |

## Errors

- Throws error if the API request fails
- Throws error if the response is not a valid array

## Example

```typescript
import { getCoinList } from 'services/coingeckoService';

async function fetchCoins() {
  try {
    const coins = await getCoinList();
    console.log(`Loaded ${coins.length} coins`);
    
    // Example of filtering coins
    const solanaRelated = coins.filter(coin => 
      coin.name.toLowerCase().includes('solana') ||
      coin.symbol.toLowerCase().includes('sol')
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch coin list:', error);
  }
}
```

# Function: getCoinMarkets()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/coingeckoService/functions/getCoinMarkets.mdx

title: "Function: getCoinMarkets()"
description: "Fetch market data for a specific coin from CoinGecko API"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [services/coingeckoService](../README.mdx) / getCoinMarkets

# Function: getCoinMarkets()

> **getCoinMarkets**(`coinId`: string): `Promise<any>`

Defined in: [src/services/coingeckoService.ts:41](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/coingeckoService.ts#L41)

Fetches detailed market data for a specific cryptocurrency from the CoinGecko API.
This function retrieves current price, market cap, fully diluted valuation, 
trading volume, and more for a specific coin.

Typically used for the "coin detail" screen or when detailed information about a single
cryptocurrency is needed.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `coinId` | `string` | CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'solana') |

## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<any>` | Object containing market data for the requested coin |

### Return Object Properties

The returned object includes numerous properties such as:
- `current_price`: Current price in USD
- `market_cap`: Market capitalization in USD
- `fully_diluted_valuation`: Fully diluted valuation
- `total_volume`: 24h trading volume
- `high_24h`: 24h high price
- `low_24h`: 24h low price
- `price_change_percentage_24h`: 24h price change percentage
- `image`: Icon image URL
- And many more

## Errors

- Throws error if the API request fails (e.g., 404 for non-existent coin)
- Throws error if no market data is available for the specified coin

## Example

```typescript
import { getCoinMarkets } from 'services/coingeckoService';

async function fetchSolanaMarketData() {
  try {
    const solanaData = await getCoinMarkets('solana');
    console.log(`Current Solana price: $${solanaData.current_price}`);
    console.log(`Market Cap: $${solanaData.market_cap.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log(`24h Change: ${solanaData.price_change_percentage_24h.toFixed(2)}%`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch Solana market data:', error);
  }
}
```

# Function: getCoinOHLC()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/coingeckoService/functions/getCoinOHLC.mdx

title: "Function: getCoinOHLC()"
description: "Fetch OHLC price data for a specific coin from CoinGecko API"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [services/coingeckoService](../README.mdx) / getCoinOHLC

# Function: getCoinOHLC()

> **getCoinOHLC**(`coinId`: string, `days`: string): `Promise<Array<number[]>>`

Defined in: [src/services/coingeckoService.ts:66](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/coingeckoService.ts#L66)

Fetches OHLC (Open-High-Low-Close) price data for a specific cryptocurrency over a given time period.
This function is primarily used for generating price charts and tracking price movements over time.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `coinId` | `string` | CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'solana') |
| `days` | `string` | Time period for data. Accepted values: '1', '7', '14', '30', '90', '180', '365', 'max' |

## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<Array<number[]>>` | Array of OHLC data points, where each data point is an array of numbers |

### Return Data Format

Each item in the returned array is an array with the following structure:
`[timestamp, open, high, low, close]`

- `timestamp`: Unix timestamp in milliseconds
- `open`: Opening price for the period
- `high`: Highest price during the period
- `low`: Lowest price during the period
- `close`: Closing price for the period

## Errors

- Throws error if the API request fails (e.g., 404 for non-existent coin)
- Throws error if the response is not a valid array

## Example

```typescript
import { getCoinOHLC } from 'services/coingeckoService';

async function fetchBitcoinChart() {
  try {
    // Get 30-day OHLC data for Bitcoin
    const ohlcData = await getCoinOHLC('bitcoin', '30');
    
    // Extract closing prices and timestamps for a chart
    const timestamps = ohlcData.map(item => item[0]);
    const closingPrices = ohlcData.map(item => item[4]);
    
    // Calculate price change over the period
    const startPrice = closingPrices[0];
    const endPrice = closingPrices[closingPrices.length - 1];
    const percentChange = ((endPrice - startPrice) / startPrice) * 100;
    
    console.log(`Bitcoin 30-day change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch Bitcoin OHLC data:', error);
  }
}
```

# services/coingeckoService

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/coingeckoService/README.mdx

title: "services/coingeckoService"
description: "Service for accessing cryptocurrency data from CoinGecko API"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../README.mdx) / services/coingeckoService

# services/coingeckoService

A collection of asynchronous functions to interface with the CoinGecko API. This service enables fetching cryptocurrency data including coin listings, market data, and OHLC (Open-High-Low-Close) price charts. All fetch logic resides in this service to keep business logic separate from hooks and components.

## Features

- Fetch comprehensive coin listings from CoinGecko
- Retrieve detailed market data for specific coins
- Access historical price data in various timeframes
- Error handling for API responses

## Functions

- [getCoinList](functions/getCoinList.mdx) - Fetch the full list of coins from CoinGecko
- [getCoinMarkets](functions/getCoinMarkets.mdx) - Fetch market data for a specific coin
- [getCoinOHLC](functions/getCoinOHLC.mdx) - Fetch OHLC price data for a specific coin

---

# Function: checkIfUserFollowsMe()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/profileService/functions/checkIfUserFollowsMe.mdx

title: "Function: checkIfUserFollowsMe()"
description: "Check if a specific user follows the current user"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [services/profileService](../README.mdx) / checkIfUserFollowsMe

# Function: checkIfUserFollowsMe()

> **checkIfUserFollowsMe**(`myWallet`: string, `userWallet`: string): `Promise<boolean>`

Defined in: [src/services/profileService.ts:90](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/profileService.ts#L90)

Checks if a target user is following the current user. This function determines if a specific
user (identified by `userWallet`) is in the followers list of the current user (identified by `myWallet`).

This is useful for creating follow-back functionality or determining reciprocal follow relationships.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `myWallet` | `string` | The current user's wallet address |
| `userWallet` | `string` | The target user's wallet address to check |

## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<boolean>` | `true` if the target user follows the current user, `false` otherwise |

## Behavior

- Returns `false` if the server URL is not configured
- Returns `false` if the server returns an unsuccessful response
- Logs warnings to the console on errors but does not throw exceptions

## Example

```typescript
import { checkIfUserFollowsMe } from 'services/profileService';

async function checkAndDisplayFollowRelationship(myAddress: string, otherUserAddress: string) {
  try {
    const theyFollowMe = await checkIfUserFollowsMe(myAddress, otherUserAddress);
    
    if (theyFollowMe) {
      console.log(`${otherUserAddress} follows you!`);
      // Enable follow back button or show appropriate UI
    } else {
      console.log(`${otherUserAddress} does not follow you.`);
      // Show regular follow button
    }
    
    return theyFollowMe;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Error checking follow relationship:', error);
    return false;
  }
}
```

# Function: fetchFollowers()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/profileService/functions/fetchFollowers.mdx

title: "Function: fetchFollowers()"
description: "Fetch the list of followers for a specific user"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [services/profileService](../README.mdx) / fetchFollowers

# Function: fetchFollowers()

> **fetchFollowers**(`userId`: string): `Promise<any[]>`

Defined in: [src/services/profileService.ts:43](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/profileService.ts#L43)

Fetches a list of users who follow the specified user. This function retrieves the follower
data from the server, allowing applications to display social connections between users.

## Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `userId` | `string` | The user's wallet address or unique ID |
```
## Returns
```
| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<any[]>` | Array of follower objects, each representing a user who follows the specified user |
```

## Behavior

- Returns an empty array if the server URL is not configured
- Returns an empty array if the server returns an unsuccessful response
- Logs warnings to the console on errors but does not throw exceptions

## Example

```typescript
import { fetchFollowers } from 'services/profileService';

async function displayUserFollowers(walletAddress: string) {
  try {
    const followers = await fetchFollowers(walletAddress);
    console.log(`${walletAddress} has ${followers.length} followers`);
    
    // Example of displaying followers
    followers.forEach(follower => {
      console.log(`- ${follower.displayName || follower.id}`);
    });
    
    return followers;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Error retrieving followers:', error);
    return [];
  }
}
```

# Function: fetchUserProfile()

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

# Function: fetchUserProfile()

> **fetchUserProfile**(`userId`: string): `Promise<{ url: string; username: string; attachmentData: any }>`

Defined in: [src/services/profileService.ts:114](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/profileService.ts#L114)

Retrieves a user's complete profile information from the server. This function fetches profile details
including profile image URL, username, and any additional attachment data associated with the user.

## Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `userId` | `string` | The user's wallet address or unique ID |
```
## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<{ url: string; username: string; attachmentData: any }>` | Object containing the user's profile information |

### Return Object Properties

- `url`: URL to the user's profile image
- `username`: The user's display name
- `attachmentData`: Additional profile data (varies based on implementation)

## Errors

- Throws an error if the profile fetch request fails

## Example

```typescript
import { fetchUserProfile } from 'services/profileService';

async function loadAndDisplayUserProfile(walletAddress: string) {
  try {
    const profileData = await fetchUserProfile(walletAddress);
    
    console.log(`Username: ${profileData.username}`);
    console.log(`Profile Image: ${profileData.url}`);
    
    // Example of using the profile data in a React component
    return (
      <View>
        <Image source={{ uri: profileData.url }} style={styles.avatar} />
        <Text style={styles.username}>{profileData.username}</Text>
        {profileData.attachmentData.bio && (
          <Text style={styles.bio}>{profileData.attachmentData.bio}</Text>
        )}
      </View>
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error loading user profile:', error);
    // Handle the error or show a default profile
  }
}
```

# Function: uploadProfileAvatar()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/profileService/functions/uploadProfileAvatar.mdx

title: "Function: uploadProfileAvatar()"
description: "Upload a profile avatar image for a specific user"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / [services/profileService](../README.mdx) / uploadProfileAvatar

# Function: uploadProfileAvatar()

> **uploadProfileAvatar**(`userWallet`: string, `localFileUri`: string): `Promise<string>`

Defined in: [src/services/profileService.ts:14](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/profileService.ts#L14)

Uploads a profile avatar image for a given user to the server. This function handles the multipart/form-data
request required for file uploads and returns the remote URL where the avatar can be accessed.

## Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `userWallet` | `string` | The user's wallet address (unique ID) |
| `localFileUri` | `string` | Local file URI of the image to upload |
```
## Returns
```
| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<string>` | The remote URL where the uploaded avatar can be accessed |
```
## Errors

- Throws error if any required parameters are missing
- Throws error if the server request fails
- Throws error if the server returns an unsuccessful response

## Example

```typescript
import { uploadProfileAvatar } from 'services/profileService';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';

async function selectAndUploadAvatar(userWalletAddress: string) {
  try {
    // Pick an image from the device
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsEditing: true,
      aspect: [1, 1],
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    
    if (!result.canceled && result.assets && result.assets.length > 0) {
      const selectedImageUri = result.assets[0].uri;
      
      // Upload the selected image as profile avatar
      const avatarUrl = await uploadProfileAvatar(userWalletAddress, selectedImageUri);
      console.log('Avatar uploaded successfully:', avatarUrl);
      
      // You can now update your UI or state with the new avatar URL
      return avatarUrl;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to upload avatar:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

# services/profileService

Service module that handles profile-related server requests and operations. This service provides functions for managing user profiles, including avatar uploads, follower relationships, and profile data retrieval.

## Features

- Upload profile avatar images to the server
- Manage social connections (followers/following)
- Check follow relationships between users
- Retrieve user profile information

## Functions

- [uploadProfileAvatar](functions/uploadProfileAvatar.mdx) - Upload a user's profile avatar image
- [fetchFollowers](functions/fetchFollowers.mdx) - Retrieve a user's followers
- [fetchFollowing](functions/fetchFollowing.mdx) - Retrieve the users a specified user is following
- [checkIfUserFollowsMe](functions/checkIfUserFollowsMe.mdx) - Check if a specific user follows the current user
- [fetchUserProfile](functions/fetchUserProfile.mdx) - Retrieve a user's complete profile information

# Function: buyTokenViaPumpfun()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService/functions/buyTokenViaPumpfun.mdx

title: "Function: buyTokenViaPumpfun()"
description: "Purchase tokens via Pump.fun or Raydium based on token availability"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../../README.mdx) / [services/pumpfun/pumpfunService](../README.mdx) / buyTokenViaPumpfun

# Function: buyTokenViaPumpfun()

> **buyTokenViaPumpfun**(`params`): `Promise<{ success: boolean; txId: string }>`

Defined in: [src/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService.ts:181](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService.ts#L181)

Buys tokens using either Pump.fun or Raydium DEX automatically.
This function first checks if the token is available on Raydium, and if so, uses Raydium's swap API.
Otherwise, it falls back to using Pump.fun's bonding curve.

## Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `params` | `Object` | Parameters for token purchase |
| `params.buyerPublicKey` | `string` | Public key of the buyer wallet |
| `params.tokenAddress` | `string` | Mint address of the token to buy |
| `params.solAmount` | `number` | Amount of SOL to spend |
| `params.solanaWallet` | `any` | Privy wallet instance for signing transactions |
```
## Returns

| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<{ success: boolean; txId: string }>` | Transaction result with signature |

## Example

```typescript
const { txId, success } = await buyTokenViaPumpfun({
  buyerPublicKey: wallet.publicKey,
  tokenAddress: "5tMi5XcfuLBzxjPZ5RzPUgbcbGNnUQnBkRoqP9DP5gGF",
  solAmount: 0.1,
  solanaWallet: wallet
});
```

# Function: createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService/functions/createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun.mdx

title: "Function: createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun()"
description: "Create a new token and immediately purchase it on Pump.fun"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../../README.mdx) / [services/pumpfun/pumpfunService](../README.mdx) / createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun

# Function: createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun()

> **createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun**(`params`): `Promise<{ success: boolean; txId: string; mintPublicKey: string }>`

Defined in: [src/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService.ts:35](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/pumpfun/pumpfunService.ts#L35)

Creates a new token and optionally buys it in a single transaction.
This function handles both token creation and initial liquidity provision:
1. Uploads token metadata and image to the server
2. Creates a new token with specified name, symbol, and metadata
3. Optionally buys the token to establish initial price

## Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `params` | `Object` | Parameters for token creation and purchase |
| `params.userPublicKey` | `string` | Public key of the creator wallet |
| `params.tokenName` | `string` | Name for the new token |
| `params.tokenSymbol` | `string` | Symbol for the new token |
| `params.description` | `string` | Description of the token |
| `params.twitter?` | `string` | Optional Twitter handle |
| `params.telegram?` | `string` | Optional Telegram group link |
| `params.website?` | `string` | Optional website URL |
| `params.imageUri` | `string` | URI to token image |
| `params.solAmount` | `number` | Amount of SOL to spend in initial buy |
| `params.slippageBasisPoints?` | `bigint` | Optional slippage tolerance (default 500 = 5%) |
| `params.solanaWallet` | `any` | Privy wallet instance for signing transactions |
```
## Returns
```
| Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ |
| `Promise<{ success: boolean; txId: string; mintPublicKey: string }>` | Transaction result with signature and new token mint address |
```
## Example

```typescript
const result = await createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun({
  userPublicKey: wallet.publicKey,
  tokenName: "My Test Token",
  tokenSymbol: "TEST",
  description: "A token for testing",
  imageUri: "file:///data/user/0/com.example/cache/ImagePicker/image.png",
  solAmount: 0.1,
  solanaWallet: wallet
});

console.log(`Created token: ${result.mintPublicKey}`);
```

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / services/pumpfun/pumpfunService

# services/pumpfun/pumpfunService

Service module that provides functions to interact with the Pump.fun platform for buying, selling, and launching tokens. This service supports both Pump.fun and Raydium DEX paths based on token availability.

## Functions

- [buyTokenViaPumpfun](functions/buyTokenViaPumpfun.mdx) - Purchase tokens via Pump.fun or Raydium
- [createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun](functions/createAndBuyTokenViaPumpfun.mdx) - Launch a new token and immediately buy
- [sellTokenViaPumpfun](functions/sellTokenViaPumpfun.mdx) - Sell tokens via Pump.fun or Raydium

---

# services/tokenMill/tokenMillService

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/tokenMill/tokenMillService/README.mdx

title: "services/tokenMill/tokenMillService"
description: "Service for creating and managing tokenized markets on Solana"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../README.mdx) / services/tokenMill/tokenMillService

# services/tokenMill/tokenMillService

Service module that provides functions to interact with tokenized markets on Solana. This service enables token creation, market management, and trading operations through a set of coordinated API calls and transaction signing.

## Functions

- [createMarket](functions/createMarket.mdx) - Create a new tokenized market
- [createVesting](functions/createVesting.mdx) - Create a vesting schedule for token recipients
- [fundMarket](functions/fundMarket.mdx) - Fund a market with SOL for operations
- [fundUserWithWSOL](functions/fundUserWithWSOL.mdx) - Wrap native SOL to WSOL for trading
- [releaseVesting](functions/releaseVesting.mdx) - Release tokens from a vesting schedule
- [setBondingCurve](functions/setBondingCurve.mdx) - Set bid/ask price curves for the market
- [stakeTokens](functions/stakeTokens.mdx) - Stake tokens in a market
- [swapTokens](functions/swapTokens.mdx) - Buy or sell tokens in a market

---

# Function: usePrivyWalletLogic()

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/walletProviders/privy/functions/usePrivyWalletLogic.mdx

title: "Function: usePrivyWalletLogic()"
description: "Hook for integrating with Privy's embedded Solana wallet"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../../../README.mdx) / [services/walletProviders/privy](../README.mdx) / usePrivyWalletLogic

# Function: usePrivyWalletLogic()

> **usePrivyWalletLogic**(): `{
>   user: null | PrivyUser;
>   isReady: boolean;
>   solanaWallet: EmbeddedSolanaWalletState;
>   handlePrivyLogin: (options: LoginOptions) => Promise<void>;
>   handlePrivyLogout: (setStatusMessage?: (msg: string) => void) => Promise<void>;
>   monitorSolanaWallet: (options: MonitorOptions) => Promise<void>;
>   handleWalletRecovery: (options: RecoveryOptions) => Promise<void>;
> }`

Defined in: [src/services/walletProviders/privy.ts:13](https://github.com/SendArcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/src/services/walletProviders/privy.ts#L13)

A hook that provides a complete wallet logic implementation using Privy's embedded wallets.
This includes user authentication, embedded wallet creation/recovery, and connection monitoring.

## Returns

An object containing:

### User Data
```
| Property | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `user` | `null \| PrivyUser` | Current authenticated user (or null if not logged in) |
| `isReady` | `boolean` | Whether the Privy SDK is initialized and ready |
| `solanaWallet` | `EmbeddedSolanaWalletState` | State of the embedded Solana wallet |
```
### Authentication Methods

#### handlePrivyLogin()

> **handlePrivyLogin**(`options: LoginOptions`): `Promise<void>`

Initiates the Privy login flow with the specified login method.

##### Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `options` | `Object` | Login configuration |
| `options.loginMethod` | `'email' \| 'sms' \| 'apple' \| 'google'` | Authentication method to use (defaults to 'email') |
| `options.setStatusMessage?` | `(msg: string) => void` | Optional callback for status updates |
```
#### handlePrivyLogout()

> **handlePrivyLogout**(`setStatusMessage?: (msg: string) => void`): `Promise<void>`

Logs out the current user from Privy.

##### Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `setStatusMessage?` | `(msg: string) => void` | Optional callback for status updates |
```
### Wallet Management Methods

#### monitorSolanaWallet()

> **monitorSolanaWallet**(`options: MonitorOptions`): `Promise<void>`

Monitors the state of the embedded Solana wallet, handling initial setup.

##### Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `options` | `Object` | Monitor options |
| `options.selectedProvider` | `string` | The selected wallet provider (e.g. 'privy') |
| `options.setStatusMessage?` | `(msg: string) => void` | Optional callback for status updates |
| `options.onWalletConnected?` | `(info: {provider: 'privy', address: string}) => void` | Callback when wallet connects |
```
#### handleWalletRecovery()

> **handleWalletRecovery**(`options: RecoveryOptions`): `Promise<void>`

Initiates wallet recovery using the specified method.

##### Parameters
```
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `options` | `Object` | Recovery options |
| `options.recoveryMethod` | `'user-passcode' \| 'google-drive' \| 'icloud'` | Recovery method to use |
| `options.password` | `string` | Recovery password |
| `options.setStatusMessage?` | `(msg: string) => void` | Optional callback for status updates |
| `options.onWalletRecovered?` | `(info: {provider: 'privy', address: string}) => void` | Callback when wallet is recovered |
```
## Example

```typescript
const { 
  user, 
  isReady, 
  solanaWallet, 
  handlePrivyLogin, 
  monitorSolanaWallet 
} = usePrivyWalletLogic();

// Login with email
await handlePrivyLogin({ 
  loginMethod: 'email', 
  setStatusMessage: (msg) => setStatus(msg) 
});

// Monitor wallet after login
await monitorSolanaWallet({
  selectedProvider: 'privy',
  setStatusMessage: (msg) => setStatus(msg),
  onWalletConnected: (info) => {
    dispatch(setAddress(info.address));
  }
});
```

# services/walletProviders/privy

Service module that provides integration with Privy's embedded wallet solution. Privy offers a streamlined authentication and wallet experience with embedded Solana wallets that don't require separate wallet extensions.

## Features

- Email, SMS, and social authentication options
- Embedded Solana wallet creation and management
- Wallet recovery options (passcode, Google Drive, iCloud)
- Transaction signing capabilities

## Functions

- [usePrivyWalletLogic](functions/usePrivyWalletLogic.mdx) - Hook for interacting with Privy embedded wallets

## References

### default

Renames and re-exports [usePrivyWalletLogic](functions/usePrivyWalletLogic.mdx)

# services/walletProviders

Source: https://github.com/sendarcade/solana-app-kit/blob/main/docs/references/services/walletProviders/README.mdx

title: "services/walletProviders"
description: "Wallet integration services for various providers"

[**solana-social-kit**](../../README.mdx)

[solana-social-kit](../../README.mdx) / services/walletProviders

# services/walletProviders

This module provides adapters and services for different wallet providers, allowing a unified interface for interacting with different wallet technologies. Currently supported providers include:

## Modules

- [dynamic](dynamic/README.mdx) - Integration with Dynamic wallet adapter
- [privy](privy/README.mdx) - Integration with Privy embedded wallet
- [turnkey](turnkey/README.mdx) - Integration with Turnkey wallet infrastructure

## Overview

Each wallet provider implementation follows a similar pattern, offering functions for:
- User authentication (login/logout)
- Wallet creation and management
- Transaction signing
- Provider-specific features

Applications can switch between different wallet implementations by using the configuration system and `useAuth` hook which delegates to the appropriate provider.

## References

### getDynamicClient

Re-exports [getDynamicClient](dynamic/functions/getDynamicClient.mdx)

### handleTurnkeyConnect

Re-exports [handleTurnkeyConnect](turnkey/functions/handleTurnkeyConnect.mdx)

### initDynamicClient

Re-exports [initDynamicClient](dynamic/functions/initDynamicClient.mdx)

### usePrivyWalletLogic

Re-exports [usePrivyWalletLogic](privy/functions/usePrivyWalletLogic.mdx)

---
